default.name: Spark Default (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, pinned production route - no swap dependency). context 60000: see docs/opencode-context-limit.md - it is neither the backend's 262144 nor a guess, and changing it changes how often the agent loses its working memory.

default-nothink.name: Spark Default with thinking disabled (same deepseek-v4-flash backend as `default`; LiteLLM forces thinking:{type:disabled} via extra_body). The route exists because opencode can only select a model NAME - its options/variants fields never reach the wire request. Same context budget and rationale as `default`: see docs/opencode-context-limit.md.
